Compliance and enforcement & Compliance starts at 0.46 and moves with legitimacy 0.24, dynamic compliance norm 0.22, implementation capacity 0.10, court independence 0.06, conflict penalties, emergency-without-merits penalty 0.08, override penalty 0.10, and executive pressure 0.08. Case selection access & Intake access combines structural review access, realized intake acceptance, litigant capacity, public-interest support, ombudsman or public-defender participation, rights-impact statements, and inverse government repeat-player advantage. \\
Legislative-response credibility & Response credibility combines mechanism triggers, rights threat, public support, legislative mandate, party-system compatibility, civil-society capacity, implementation capacity, and inverse electoral time pressure. \\
Directional score & Unweighted average of 35 display metrics after reversing lower-is-better measures. It is a diagnostic display score and not a welfare function or fitted objective. \\
Legal-transplant feasibility & Scenario transplant score, political-culture fit, case public trust, legal-tradition compatibility, implementation capacity, civil-society capacity, inverse institutional demand, and inverse political mismatch. Political-culture sensitivity & Mechanism fragility baseline plus low culture fit, legislative conflict, partisan pressure, party fragmentation, electoral time pressure, constitutional conflict, implementation complexity, state-federal tension, and low implementation or civil-society capacity. Veto-relocation risk & Low-rights interventions, council or cross-check veto points, intake-screening intensity, upstream cost, low acceptance rate, high independence, low transparency, government repeat-player advantage, and low case-selection access increase risk.
